discovery_target: Purged expanding-fold OOF residual of within-date clipped-return percentile rank, versus weighted standard-scaler/Ridge on all 38 baseline inputs. Later survival residual uses a reference fitted ONLY on the prefix.
inputs: 19 causal OHLCV values and same-close eligible-universe ranks, defined before observing outcomes
selection: Prefix-only genetic evolution against OOF residuals. Reject linear-span copies using prefix-only residual fraction. Three later TRAIN-only survival blocks, no calibration/policy/test search.
downstream: Fixed weighted scaler/logistic C=0.3: rank-only versus rank+surviving residual formulas. Matched raw-19 Extra Trees control, same dates/rows. Never choose based on external results.
missing_evaluation: Whole incomplete dates excluded with coverage reported; optional empty periods unavailable; primary empty is an error
evaluation_role: Development follow-up after v1 yielded only linear sums; NOT independent final validation. No claim that another attempt creates new holdout evidence.
